summary.from: Responder a 1.e4 con 1...e5 y desarrollar con naturalidad. La línea principal es la Italiana vista desde las negras; las ramas cubren lo que suelen jugar las blancas.
summary.to: Answering 1.e4 with 1...e5 and developing naturally. The main line is the Italian seen from Black’s side; the branches cover what White usually plays.

steps.0.note.from: Las blancas ocupan el centro con el peón de rey.
steps.0.note.to: White occupies the centre with the king’s pawn.

steps.1.note.from: Respuesta simétrica: tu peón también reclama el centro y abre paso al alfil y a la dama.
steps.1.note.to: Symmetrical reply: your pawn also claims the centre and opens the way for the bishop and the queen.

steps.2.note.from: Las blancas desarrollan y atacan tu peón de e5.
steps.2.note.to: White develops and attacks your pawn on e5.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: La dama sale pronto y ataca e5 y f7, buscando el mate del pastor.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.0.note.to: The queen comes out early and attacks e5 and f7, going for Scholar’s mate.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.1.note.to: You defend e5 by developing a knight.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.2.note.from: El alfil se suma al ataque contra f7: amenazan mate.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.2.note.to: The bishop joins the attack on f7: they threaten mate.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.3.note.from: Cierras el paso a la dama y la obligas a moverse otra vez.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.3.note.to: You block the queen’s path and force her to move again.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.4.note.from: La dama sigue apuntando a f7.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.4.note.to: The queen keeps aiming at f7.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.5.note.from: El caballo tapa la diagonal hacia f7 y se desarrolla. Ya no hay mate.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.5.note.to: The knight blocks the diagonal towards f7 and develops. No more mate.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.6.note.from: Las blancas desarrollan, pero han perdido tiempo con la dama.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.6.note.to: White develops, but has lost time with the queen.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.7.note.from: El alfil sale por la casilla que abrió g6 y prepara el enroque.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.7.note.to: The bishop comes out through the square opened by g6 and prepares castling.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas desarrollan el caballo de dama y vigilan d5.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.0.note.to: White develops the queen’s knight and watches d5.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.1.note.from: Desarrollas y atacas el peón de e4.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.1.note.to: You develop and attack the pawn on e4.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.3.note.from: Defiendes e5 con el caballo. Es la posición de los Cuatro Caballos.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.3.note.to: You defend e5 with the knight. This is the Four Knights position.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.4.note.from: El alfil presiona tu caballo de c6, que defiende e5.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.4.note.to: The bishop puts pressure on your knight on c6, which defends e5.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.5.note.from: Copias la idea: tu alfil presiona el caballo de c3.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.5.note.to: You copy the idea: your bishop puts pressure on the knight on c3.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.8.note.from: Las blancas defienden e4 y abren la diagonal del alfil de c1.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.8.note.to: White defends e4 and opens the diagonal for the c1 bishop.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.9.note.from: Lo mismo para ti: e5 queda firme y el alfil de c8 puede salir.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.9.note.to: The same for you: e5 stands firm and the c8 bishop can come out.

steps.2.branches.2.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas ofrecen un peón para abrir la columna f y quitarte el centro.
steps.2.branches.2.steps.0.note.to: White offers a pawn to open the f-file and take the centre from you.

steps.2.branches.2.steps.1.note.from: Contraataque en el centro en lugar de aceptar el peón de inmediato.
steps.2.branches.2.steps.1.note.to: A counter-attack in the centre instead of accepting the pawn straight away.

steps.2.branches.2.steps.2.note.from: Las blancas capturan en el centro.

steps.2.branches.2.steps.3.note.from: Ahora sí tomas en f4: el rey blanco queda más expuesto.
steps.2.branches.2.steps.3.note.to: Now you take on f4: the white king is more exposed.

steps.2.branches.2.steps.5.note.from: Desarrollas y atacas el peón de d5.
steps.2.branches.2.steps.5.note.to: You develop and attack the pawn on d5.

steps.2.branches.2.steps.6.note.from: El alfil defiende d5 y apunta a f7.
steps.2.branches.2.steps.6.note.to: The bishop defends d5 and aims at f7.

steps.2.branches.2.steps.7.note.from: Recuperas el peón con una pieza bien centrada.
steps.2.branches.2.steps.7.note.to: You win the pawn back with a well-centralised piece.

steps.2.branches.2.steps.8.note.from: Las blancas ponen el rey a salvo.
steps.2.branches.2.steps.8.note.to: White puts the king in safety.

steps.2.branches.2.steps.9.note.from: Desarrollas y preparas tu propio enroque.
steps.2.branches.2.steps.9.note.to: You develop and prepare your own castling.

steps.2.branches.3.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas abren el centro de inmediato.
steps.2.branches.3.steps.0.note.to: White opens the centre straight away.

steps.2.branches.3.steps.1.note.from: Capturas: no conviene dejar que el peón blanco te empuje.
steps.2.branches.3.steps.1.note.to: You capture: it is better not to let the white pawn push you back.

steps.2.branches.3.steps.2.note.from: La dama recupera el peón, pero queda expuesta en el centro.
steps.2.branches.3.steps.2.note.to: The queen wins the pawn back, but is exposed in the centre.

steps.2.branches.3.steps.3.note.from: Desarrollas atacando a la dama: ganas un tiempo.
steps.2.branches.3.steps.3.note.to: You develop, attacking the queen: you gain a tempo.

steps.2.branches.3.steps.6.note.from: Las blancas defienden e4 con el caballo.
steps.2.branches.3.steps.6.note.to: White defends e4 with the knight.

steps.2.branches.3.steps.7.note.from: El alfil sale y presiona al defensor de e4.
steps.2.branches.3.steps.7.note.to: The bishop comes out and puts pressure on the defender of e4.

steps.2.branches.3.steps.9.note.from: Enrocas: rey a salvo y tu torre irá a e8 contra e4.
steps.2.branches.3.steps.9.note.to: You castle: king safe, and your rook will go to e8 against e4.

steps.3.note.from: Defender desarrollando: el caballo protege e5 y mira al centro.
steps.3.note.to: Defending while developing: the knight protects e5 and faces the centre.

steps.4.note.from: Es la Italiana: el alfil apunta a f7.
steps.4.note.to: This is the Italian: the bishop aims at f7.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: El alfil ataca el caballo que defiende e5.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.0.note.to: The bishop attacks the knight that defends e5.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.1.note.from: Preguntas al alfil qué quiere hacer: retirarse o cambiarse.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.1.note.to: You ask the bishop what it wants to do: retreat or exchange.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.note.from: El alfil se retira, sin dejar de presionar al caballo.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.note.to: The bishop retreats, still putting pressure on the knight.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas cambian el alfil por tu caballo.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: White trades the bishop for your knight.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Capturas hacia el centro y abres paso a tu alfil de c8 y a la dama.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: You capture towards the centre and open the way for your c8 bishop and the queen.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas enrocan; ahora sí amenazan ganar e5.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: White castles; now they really do threaten to win e5.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Defiendes e5 con un peón y mantienes tu estructura.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: You defend e5 with a pawn and keep your structure.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: El caballo recupera el peón en una buena casilla.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: The knight wins the pawn back on a good square.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Echas al caballo del centro ganando tiempo.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: You chase the knight out of the centre, gaining a tempo.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.3.note.from: Desarrollas y atacas el peón de e4.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.3.note.to: You develop and attack the pawn on e4.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.4.note.from: Las blancas enrocan y dejan e4 como cebo.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.4.note.to: White castles and leaves e4 as bait.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.5.note.to: Quiet development so you can castle early.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.6.note.from: La torre defiende e4 y amenaza de nuevo ganar e5.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.6.note.to: The rook defends e4 and once again threatens to win e5.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.7.note.from: Echas al alfil para que deje de presionar a tu caballo.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.7.note.to: You chase the bishop away so it stops pressuring your knight.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.8.note.from: El alfil se coloca en la diagonal que mira a f7.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.8.note.to: The bishop settles on the diagonal aiming at f7.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.9.note.from: Sostienes e5 y abres paso al alfil de c8.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.9.note.to: You hold e5 and open the way for the c8 bishop.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.10.note.from: Las blancas preparan d4 y dan una casilla al alfil.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.10.note.to: White prepares d4 and gives the bishop a square.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.11.note.from: Enrocas: desarrollo completo y rey a salvo.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.11.note.to: You castle: development complete and king safe.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas abren el centro de inmediato.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.0.note.to: White opens the centre straight away.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.1.note.from: Capturas: así no te dejan sin espacio.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.1.note.to: You capture: that way they do not cramp you.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.2.note.from: El caballo recupera el peón en el centro.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.2.note.to: The knight wins the pawn back in the centre.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.3.note.from: Desarrollas y atacas el peón de e4.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.3.note.to: You develop and attack the pawn on e4.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.note.from: Las blancas defienden e4 con el caballo.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.note.to: White defends e4 with the knight.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas cambian caballos antes de defender e4.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: White exchanges knights before defending e4.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: Capturas hacia el centro: el peón de c6 apoyará ...d5.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: You capture towards the centre: the c6 pawn will support ...d5.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: El peón echa a tu caballo de f6.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: The pawn chases your knight away from f6.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: La dama ataca el peón de e5 y clava el peón contra el rey.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: The queen attacks the pawn on e5 and pins it to the king.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas defienden e5 y cubren su rey.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: White defends e5 and shields their king.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: El caballo se instala en el centro.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: The knight settles in the centre.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: Clavas el peón de c4 contra la dama: el caballo puede quedarse.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: You pin the c4 pawn to the queen: the knight can stay.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.5.note.from: El alfil presiona al caballo que defiende e4.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.5.note.to: The bishop puts pressure on the knight that defends e4.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.9.note.from: Golpeas el centro con un peón y liberas tu alfil de c8.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.9.note.to: You strike at the centre with a pawn and free your c8 bishop.

steps.4.branches.1.steps.11.note.from: Recuperas el peón con un centro sólido.
steps.4.branches.1.steps.11.note.to: You win the pawn back with a solid centre.

steps.4.branches.2.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas desarrollan el otro caballo.

steps.4.branches.2.steps.1.note.from: Tú también: cuatro caballos en juego.
steps.4.branches.2.steps.1.note.to: You too: four knights in play.

steps.4.branches.2.steps.2.note.from: El alfil presiona tu caballo de c6.
steps.4.branches.2.steps.2.note.to: The bishop puts pressure on your knight on c6.

steps.4.branches.2.steps.3.note.to: You reply with the same idea.

steps.4.branches.2.steps.7.note.from: Sostienes e5 y abres paso al alfil de c8.
steps.4.branches.2.steps.7.note.to: You hold e5 and open the way for the c8 bishop.

steps.5.note.from: Tu alfil se coloca en la diagonal equivalente, apuntando a f2.
steps.5.note.to: Your bishop goes to the matching diagonal, aiming at f2.

steps.6.note.from: Las blancas preparan d4 para quitarte el centro.
steps.6.note.to: White prepares d4 to take the centre from you.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas defienden e4 con calma.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.1.note.to: You develop and put pressure on e4.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.3.note.from: Sostienes e5 y abres paso al alfil.
steps.6.branches.0.steps.3.note.to: You hold e5 and open the way for the bishop.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.5.note.from: Tú también: misma estructura que la línea principal.
steps.6.branches.0.steps.5.note.to: You too: the same structure as the main line.

steps.6.branches.1.steps.5.note.from: Rey a salvo: se llega a la misma posición tranquila.
steps.6.branches.1.steps.5.note.to: King safe: you reach the same quiet position.

steps.6.branches.2.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas dan un peón para ganar tiempo y montar el centro con c3 y d4.
steps.6.branches.2.steps.0.note.to: White gives a pawn to gain time and build the centre with c3 and d4.

steps.6.branches.2.steps.1.note.from: Aceptas el gambito: un peón es un peón.
steps.6.branches.2.steps.1.note.to: You accept the gambit: a pawn is a pawn.

steps.6.branches.2.steps.2.note.from: Las blancas echan a tu alfil y preparan d4.
steps.6.branches.2.steps.2.note.to: White chases your bishop away and prepares d4.

steps.6.branches.2.steps.3.note.from: Retirada sólida: el alfil defiende tu flanco de rey.
steps.6.branches.2.steps.3.note.to: A solid retreat: the bishop defends your kingside.

steps.6.branches.2.steps.5.note.from: Atacas el alfil que apunta a f7.
steps.6.branches.2.steps.5.note.to: You attack the bishop that aims at f7.

steps.6.branches.2.steps.6.note.from: El alfil se aparta y defiende el centro.
steps.6.branches.2.steps.6.note.to: The bishop steps aside and defends the centre.

steps.6.branches.2.steps.8.note.from: La dama blanca recupera y ataca g7.
steps.6.branches.2.steps.8.note.to: The white queen recaptures and attacks g7.

steps.6.branches.2.steps.10.note.from: Las blancas echan a tu caballo.

steps.6.branches.2.steps.11.note.from: Atacas a la dama con el otro caballo, que vuelve al centro.
steps.6.branches.2.steps.11.note.to: You attack the queen with the other knight, which comes back to the centre.

steps.6.branches.2.steps.12.note.from: La dama se aparta, sin dejar de mirar a tu flanco de rey.
steps.6.branches.2.steps.12.note.to: The queen steps aside, still eyeing your kingside.

steps.6.branches.2.steps.13.note.from: El caballo se instala en el centro: sigues con un peón de más.
steps.6.branches.2.steps.13.note.to: The knight settles in the centre: you are still a pawn up.

steps.7.note.from: Otra pieza fuera, presionando el peón de e4.
steps.7.note.to: Another piece out, putting pressure on the e4 pawn.

steps.8.note.from: Las blancas defienden e4: es la versión tranquila.
steps.8.note.to: White defends e4: this is the quiet version.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas van a por el centro de inmediato.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.0.note.to: White goes for the centre straight away.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.1.note.to: You exchange: you cannot hold e5.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.2.note.from: Las blancas forman un centro de dos peones.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas echan a tu caballo en lugar de recuperar el peón.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: White chases your knight away instead of winning the pawn back.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Contraataque en el centro: atacas el alfil de c4.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: A counter-attack in the centre: you attack the c4 bishop.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: El alfil se aparta y clava tu caballo.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: The bishop steps aside and pins your knight.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: El caballo se instala en el centro.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: The knight settles in the centre.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: El alfil se retira a una diagonal segura.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: The bishop retreats to a safe diagonal.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.3.note.from: Jaque: obligas a las blancas a tapar.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.3.note.to: Check: you force White to block.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.note.from: Las blancas tapan y ofrecen cambiar alfiles.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.note.to: White blocks and offers a bishop trade.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas sacrifican el peón de e4.
Lo tomas: tu caballo ataca al de c3.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: You take it: your knight attacks the one on c3.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas enrocan y dejan el caballo.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: White castles and leaves the knight.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: Ganas una pieza por un momento.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: You win a piece for the moment.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: La idea de Møller: el peón ataca tu caballo de c6.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: Møller’s idea: the pawn attacks your knight on c6.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: El alfil vuelve a defender tu flanco de rey.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: The bishop goes back to defend your kingside.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: La torre clava tu caballo de e4.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: The rook pins your knight on e4.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: El caballo se aparta y defiende.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: The knight steps aside and defends.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: Liberas tu alfil de c8 y frenas el peón de d5.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: You free your c8 bishop and stop the d5 pawn.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas cambian el defensor de tu rey.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: White trades off the defender of your king.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: Enrocas: tienes un peón de más y puedes defender h7.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: You castle: you are a pawn up and can defend h7.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.6.note.from: Las blancas recuperan con el caballo.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.7.note.from: Golpeas el centro antes de que avance e5.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.7.note.to: You strike at the centre before e5 comes.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.10.note.from: La dama ataca tu caballo de d5.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.10.note.to: The queen attacks your knight on d5.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.11.note.from: Lo defiendes con el otro caballo.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.11.note.to: You defend it with the other knight.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.13.note.from: Rey a salvo: el peón de d4 aislado puede ser una debilidad.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.13.note.to: King safe: the isolated d4 pawn may become a weakness.

steps.9.note.from: Sostienes e5 y abres paso a tu alfil de c8.
steps.9.note.to: You hold e5 and open the way for your c8 bishop.

steps.10.note.from: Las blancas ponen el rey a salvo.
steps.10.note.to: White puts the king in safety.

steps.11.note.from: Tú también: rey a salvo y torre conectada.
steps.11.note.to: You too: king safe and rook connected.

steps.12.note.from: La torre blanca se coloca detrás de e4.
steps.12.note.to: The white rook goes behind e4.

steps.13.note.from: Das al alfil una casilla de retirada antes de que lo molesten con b4 o d4.
steps.13.note.to: You give the bishop a retreat square before it is harassed by b4 or d4.

steps.14.note.from: El alfil blanco se aparta sin dejar de mirar a f7.
steps.14.note.to: The white bishop steps back, still aiming at f7.

steps.15.note.from: Tu alfil se pone a salvo en la misma diagonal.
steps.15.note.to: Your bishop gets to safety on the same diagonal.

steps.16.note.from: Las blancas impiden ...Ag4 y dan aire a su rey.
